page_title: MON 1-1 HAV | Monaco v Le Havre 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Monaco control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Andre Ayew (Le Havre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) picks up a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A raking crossfield pass from Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
89' Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) is coming onto the pitch as Arouna Sangante cannot continue after picking up an injury.
88' Substitution. Daler Kuzyaev will be replaced by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre).
87' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replacing Emmanuel Sabbi.
87' Substitution. Ismail Jakobs did his best and is replaced by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco).
86' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
85' Monaco are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
83' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

83' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Monaco.
82' Arthur Desmas makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) after a cross from the side.
80' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
78' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Yassine Kechta (Le Havre), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
75' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
75' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' The free kick is taken by Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco), but ball is cleared.
73' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Monaco have been awarded a free kick.
72' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) tries to find Ismail Jakobs with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
71' Adi Hutter decides to make a substitution. Maghnes Akliouche will be replaced by Takumi Minamino (Monaco).
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Loic Nego (Le Havre) comes onto the pitch so that Rassoul Ndiaye can be given a rest.
70' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
69' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) plays a through ball but overhits it.
65' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. A slightly disorientated Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) puts the ball into his own net.
65' Le Havre have a free kick.
63' 1 - 0 Goal! Maghnes Akliouche tees up Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:0.
62' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
61' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Antoine Joujou and he is replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
60' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) earns the yellow card.
58' A cross by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
57' A substitution has been made. Eliesse Ben Seghir is replaced by Krepin Diatta (Monaco).
57' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
55' It will be a corner kick for Le Havre.
52' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) finds himself some space to meet the corner and strikes the ball. He sends it towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a spectacular save to thwart him.
52' Monaco get a corner.
52' The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
51' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Corner kick. Monaco will have an opportunity.
51' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
51' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but Philipp Kohn comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' A cross from a corner kick by Le Havre is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
50' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Le Havre will take a corner kick.
49' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
47' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
46' The corner kick from Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
44' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) dribbles into the box, but Arthur Desmas is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
42' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
41' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
39' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) whips in a cross from the corner, but Philipp Kohn is well positioned and punches the ball away.
38' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Christopher Operi (Le Havre), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.
37' The ball is cleared after Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' The free kick is delivered by Christopher Operi (Le Havre) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
33' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
31' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
30' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

26' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball. The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
24' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) is caught offside!
23' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
20' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jerome Brisard signals.
19' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

18' What a wasted opportunity by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Arthur Desmas makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
18' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
17' Le Havre couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Philipp Kohn (Monaco) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
17' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Thilo Kehrer (Monaco). There is a free kick near the sideline to Le Havre.
16' The Monaco players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
14' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

13' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
12' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) receives a reproachful look from Vanderson. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
10' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Philipp Kohn, who smothers the ball.
7' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
6' A cross into the box from Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is cleared.
3' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post.
2' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
Le Havre will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard will referee today's match.
